User-agent rotation config is accepted and crawl succeeds

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'user_agents' => ['Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0)', 'Chrome/120.0.0.0'] }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url)
puts result.inspect
```
